description: Half-season manager records with games managed equal to 53 or higher are included.

d.request: Using only `manager_half` rows where games managed `g` is 53 or more (`g >= 53`), compute each team's average of the loss rate `l / g` (ignoring NULLs), then take the average of those per-team averages across all teams (ignoring NULLs) as a single unrounded number.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS result FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 GROUP BY team_id)

a.request: Using only `manager_half` records where games managed (`g`) is at least 53, compute each team's average of losses divided by games managed (`l` / `g`), ignoring missing values. Then give the average of those per-team averages across all teams, ignoring missing values, as a single unrounded value.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 GROUP BY team_id)

b.request: Using only `manager_half` rows where `g` is at least 53, compute each team's (grouped by `team_id`) average of `l`/`g` per row, skipping NULLs, then return the unrounded average of those per-team averages across all teams, skipping NULLs.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 GROUP BY team_id)
b.raw: Using only `manager_half` rows where `g` is at least 53, compute each team's (grouped by `team_id`) average of `l`/`g` per row, skipping NULLs, then return the unrounded average of those per-team averages across all teams, skipping NULLs.

c.request: Looking only at `manager_half` stints where games managed (`g`) pass the 53-game mark, what is each team's average loss rate (losses `l` divided by games managed `g`, ignoring missing values)? Give the average of those team averages across all teams, ignoring missing values, as a single unrounded number. Half-season manager records with games managed equal to 53 or higher are included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g >= 53 AND l IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id)
